newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wong's Kong King in HK$49 mln rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Wong's Kong King in HK$49 mln rights plan.

text.p: Wong's Kong King International (Holdings) Ltd proposed to raise HK$49 million before expenses by way of a rights issue of not less than 199.92 million new shares at HK$0.25 per share on the basis of two rights shares for every five shares held, the company said on Wednesday.
Its shares ended at HK$0.29 on Tuesday.

The company said the number of rights shares would be increased to 201.01 million shares, or 28.57 percent of the expanded share capital, on exercise in full of the outstanding options in respect of a total 2.73 million shares.
ING Capital Markets (Hong Kong) Ltd has been appointed as manager and underwriter of the issue.
The company said HK$20 million of the proceed would be used to repay bank borrowings and HK$27 million for working captial.
"The rights issue will provide the group with the necessary capital to reduce its gearing level and interest expense," said the company's chairamn Senta Wong in the statement.

Wong-controlled Greatway Co Inc and W.S. Wong & Sons Co Ltd, 19 percent owned by Greatway, respectively hold 26.20 and 20.72 percent of Wong's Kong King, a company which trades chemicals and equipment used in the manufacture of electronic products.
